name: Katrina
overview: Scripture reveals God's sovereign authority over storms and natural disasters, affirming that the LORD reigns eternally above the floods and controls the whirlwind and storm (Psalms 29:10; Nahum 1:3). He is our refuge and strength, providing help in times of trouble and calming the fiercest waves (Psalms 46:1; 107:29). God's presence assures believers that even when passing through overwhelming waters or fire, they will not be overcome, as He faithfully protects those who trust in Him (Isaiah 43:2; Nahum 1:7). This truth encourages reliance on God's power and goodness amid life's trials and calamities.
